title: Protected Sites & Tenant WAF Policy Management

invariants_enforced: Strict DDD architectural boundaries (0 forbidden imports in domain layers)
Cross-tenant isolation (404 Not Found without existence leakage)
Strict RBAC hierarchy (OWNER, ADMIN, ANALYST, VIEWER)
Domain FQDN validation & SSRF protection on upstream origin URLs
Threshold ordering invariant (0.0 < monitor < challenge < block <= 1.0)
Anti-wildcard scoped exclusions with required justification
